📚Remember Anything With These Tricks 1. Mnemonics: create an acronym or silly phrase using the first letters of a list you need to memorize. 2. The Memory Palace: visualize walking through your house and 'placing' facts in specific rooms. 3. Rhymes and songs make information sticky — set boring content to a tune and it becomes unforgettable. 4. Association: link new information to something you already know well. New knowledge needs an anchor. 5. Repetition with variation: say it, write it, draw it, teach it. Four formats = four times the retention. 6. The weirder your memory trick, the more effective it is. Bizarre associations are impossible to forget. #StudyTok #StudyMotivation #ExamPrep #StudyHacks #StudyWithMe

Traditionally made with meat - I swap in lentils and a few extra ingredients, then cook in a little olive oil until perfectly crispy and serve with creamy tahini. Making your own pitta is a little bit extra, but it’s worth the effort if you have the time! Ooey-Gooey Scoopable Nutella Cookie Pie🤤 Yields: 15-16 Chunky Cookies INGREDIENTS:  230g Cold Chopped Unsalted Butter  160g Caster Sugar  160g Light Brown Sugar  450g Chocolate Chunks or chips  475g Plain Flour  1 tsp Salt 3 tsp Baking Powder  3/4 tsp Baking Soda  2 Eggs  1 Egg Yolk  1 tsp Vanilla  INSTRUCTIONS: •Cut cling wrap into small squares. Scoop ½ teaspoon Nutella onto individual cling-wrap squares. Fold to seal and freeze until solid. (Repeat for however many Nutella stuffed cookies you plan to make.) •In a large mixing bowl, add the cold cubed butter and whisk until slightly creamy. Add the white sugar and light brown sugar, then whisk together until well combined and fluffy. •Add the eggs, vanilla extract, and chocolate chips or chunks. Whisk until fully incorporated. •Add the flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Gently mix until just combined, do not overmix. •Portion the dough into 90g balls. Press a frozen Nutella piece into the centre of each dough ball, seal well, and roll into a smooth ball. •Place the stuffed cookie dough balls onto a tray and freeze for at least 30 minutes (or overnight for best results). •Preheat oven to 180°C (350°F). •Take any shape baking dish circle, square, rectangle anything and line it with parchment paper. Arrange frozen cookie dough balls in it leaving some space between them. •Bake for 10-15 minutes (timing depends on the type of pan) or until the tops are lightly golden while the centres remain soft and gooey. •Remove from the oven and let cool slightly. •Serve warm with ice cream and chocolate sauce enjoy!✨ NOTE: Store any extra dough balls in an airtight container or freezer bag and freeze for later. Whenever a cookie craving hits, bake straight from frozen🫶🏻 #cookie #nutella #cookiepie #fyp #viral

• 2 cups granulated sugar (420g) • 4 large eggs at room temperature • 1 cup salted butter melted or browned (226g) • 2/3 cup cocoa powder (62g) • 3/4 cup all-purpose flour (98g) Instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a pan. Beat sugar and eggs until sugar is completely dissolved and the mixture turns pale and glossy. Add in melted butter. Sift cocoa and flour and fold into the wet mixture for smooth, lump-free batter. Pour into 9x9  pan and bake 33-38 minutes until fudgy in the center. Let cool completely, slice, and enjoy! #baking #brownierecipe #5ingredientrecipe #bakingrecipe #easybaking

#mascara  Le mascara est un produit cosmétique destiné à maquiller les cils en les allongeant, les épaississant, les recourbant ou en intensifiant leur couleur afin de mettre en valeur le regard. Il se présente généralement sous forme liquide ou crémeuse, appliqué à l’aide d’une brosse spécifique, et contient des pigments, des cires et des agents fixateurs permettant d’améliorer l’apparence des cils tout en assurant une bonne tenue du maquillage.

#mascara                                    Un mascara est un produit de maquillage destiné à être appliqué sur les cils afin de les allonger, les épaissir, les recourber et intensifier le regard. Il se présente généralement sous forme liquide ou crémeuse, contenu dans un tube avec une brosse applicatrice. Le mascara permet de donner plus de volume et de définition aux cils en les colorant, le plus souvent en noir, mais aussi en brun ou en couleurs plus originales. Selon sa formule et la forme de la brosse, il peut offrir différents effets : naturel, volumineux, allongeant ou recourbant. Facile à utiliser, il est un élément essentiel du maquillage des yeux, mais reste temporaire et s’enlève avec un démaquillant adapté.                     #lashes #prt #fyp #foryoupagе
